title: Infinitesimal Bialgebra on Planar Binary Trees
summary: We construct a weight-zero infinitesimal bialgebra structure on the $\bk$-module spanned by planar binary trees, using the under product $\backslash$ of Aguiar--Sottileand a root-recursive coproduct $\DeltaLR$. We prove that $\DeltaLR$ is coassociative and satisfies the infinitesimal derivation rule with respect to $\backslash$, hence gives a unitary infinitesimal bialgebra distinct from the usual Loday--Ronco Hopf structure.
